content:
maria: Hey runtime + security — PR #48290 needs final eyes. It's a small routing/config change (eviction + fallback routing). @sam @alex can you take runtime? @security-eng can you check KMS/perm implications? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/48290

sam: On it, maria. Can you paste the intended canary plan and rollback criteria? :eyes:

maria: Canary plan: 10% traffic in staging for 2h, then 50% in prod for 30m if no errors. Auto rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 200ms. Config snippet: ```orchestrator: { canary: { percent: 10, duration: "2h" } }```

alex: Quick FYI — this touches the KV eviction header handling we optimized last quarter. Need a quick perf check for seq_len=512/2048. @jules can you run the microbench?

jules: I'll run microbench now, ETA ~2h. Will report p95 and memory delta.

security-eng: Scanning the change — looks like fallback branch reads from a different key; we need an extra IAM binding `roles/cryptoFallbackReader` on the fallback key. If you add that to the terraform change I'll be able to approve.

kevin: Who is owning the merge window? I can take monitoring and rollback at 15:00 PST today if that helps.

maria: Awesome — @kevin can take the merge/canary slot. @sam please add the IAM binding to the terraform plan and a short migration note in the PR.

sam: Done — pushed a commit adding the terraform IAM change and a tiny unit test for the fallback reader logic. Updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/48290

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary slot reserved at 2026-03-18T22:00Z for PR #48290 (owner: kevin)

alex: LGTM from runtime POV pending the perf numbers from @jules. No blocking code comments.

jules: Perf results: seq512 p95 +3ms, seq2048 p95 +8ms, memory +1.2% on our quantized kernels. These are within our SLO slack — happy to greenlight.

maria: :thumbsup: Great. @security-eng please confirm IAM change is acceptable and you can sign off after terraform apply to staging.

security-eng: Confirmed — IAM change looks correct. I'll approve once the terraform plan is applied to staging (small check to avoid drift).

maria: Plan: apply to staging, run the canary at reserved slot, monitor p95/5xx, then promote. Merging after canary is reserved & infra applied. Thanks everyone!
